about.title: About Rakshak
about.subtitle: Preventive Action Platform for Infrastructure Safety
about.overviewText: Infrastructure failures cause severe flooding, loss of life, and economic damage. Rakshak bridges the critical gap between citizen field observations and engineering intervention. By turning a single photograph into an actionable Health Card, Rakshak enables early detection and rapid preventive action.
about.step1Desc: Citizens or field workers capture photos of suspicious infrastructure damage.
about.step2Desc: Laplacian blur analysis verifies image sharpness, and computer vision confirms infrastructure relevance.
about.step3Desc: Visual damage indicators (cracks, erosion, seepage, settlement) are combined with historical community & engineering data.
about.step4Desc: An explainable 0–100 structural risk score is generated alongside actionable intervention steps.
about.step5Desc: High-risk reports are dispatched to local engineers and authorities for prioritized field inspection.
about.erosionDesc: Loss of protective earth on slopes or embankment toes caused by water currents.
about.seepageDesc: Water leaking through or beneath embankments, creating internal erosion pathways.
about.cracksDesc: Cracks caused by slope movement or foundation settlement.
about.settlementDesc: Downward movement or sinking of the embankment surface.
about.methodologyDesc: Risk scores are computed deterministically using weighted metrics: Erosion (25%), Cracks (25%), Seepage (20%), Settlement (15%), Additional Issues (10%), and Community History (5%). Scores range from Low (0–24) to Critical (75–100).
about.targetAssetsDesc: River embankments, canal banks, road embankments, railway slopes, and dam structures.
about.noteText: Rakshak provides a preliminary visual assessment based on submitted evidence. It does not replace an on-site professional engineering inspection.
